alt: A two-column diagram of Digital Foundry's PS5 and PS5 Pro results: both 1440p base, PS5 with possible dips to the mid-20s, PS5 Pro with a locked 30 FPS, PSSR upscaling that looks a lot like 4K, and ray-traced shadows on Pro only.

data.title: PS5 and PS5 Pro, side by side
data.subtitle: Digital Foundry's review numbers, 18 Nov. This is their analysis, not a Rockstar settings screen. Xbox is not in this review yet.
data.note: Drawn from Digital Foundry's PS5 and PS5 Pro review. We will add Xbox numbers when they publish them.
